prompt_text:
You are watching a short cooking video clip. Focus only on objects that the person touches, picks up, carries, removes, places down, or uses. List every distinct handled object, even if it is visible only briefly. Do not summarize the scene as a story. Do not ignore secondary objects. If you are unsure what an object is, describe its appearance and write 'unclear'.

Use exactly this format:
- handled_objects:
  1. object: <name or unclear>
     action: <picked up / removed / placed / carried / used / unclear>
     visual_description: <short description of shape/color/location>
     confidence: <low/medium/high>
  2. object: <name or unclear>
     action: <picked up / removed / placed / carried / used / unclear>
     visual_description: <short description of shape/color/location>
     confidence: <low/medium/high>
- missed_or_unclear_objects: [objects that may have been handled but are hard to identify]
